findings.title: Deferred cancellation can miss SendGrid’s cancellation deadline
findings.description:
Booking cancellation now only marks scheduled emails as cancelled; this cron handler performs the actual provider cancellation. However, `.github/workflows/cron-scheduleEmailReminders.yml` runs every 15 minutes, while SendGrid requires cancellation at least 10 minutes before sending. For example, cancelling a reminder due in 20 minutes just after a cron run leaves only five minutes when the next run attempts cancellation. The email can therefore still be delivered for a cancelled booking, whereas the previous implementation attempted cancellation immediately.

Cancel immediately when approaching the provider deadline, and use deferred processing only where sufficient time remains.

findings.title: One failed cancellation prevents processing the remaining reminders
findings.description:
The `try` surrounds the entire cancellation loop. If any SendGrid request fails, all subsequent reminders are skipped. Furthermore, the Prisma delete operations accumulated for earlier successful requests are lazy and never execute because `Promise.all` is not reached. Consequently, already-cancelled batches remain queued for another cancellation attempt, while unrelated cancelled bookings may still receive reminders as their deadlines pass.

Handle failures per reminder and persist each successful cancellation independently so one invalid batch or provider error cannot block the queue.

findings.title: Cancellation handlers no longer await reminder persistence
findings.description:
The previous implementation awaited deletion of the reminder records. The replacement invokes asynchronous cancellation helpers inside `forEach` and discards their promises. Since `deleteScheduledEmailReminder` now performs the database update that queues deferred cancellation, the mutation can finish without that update completing. Request-scoped or serverless execution may stop before the reminder is marked, leaving the cron handler unaware that it needs cancellation.

The same pattern appears in `handleCancelBooking.ts` and the changed workflow-update paths. Collect the helper promises and await them before completing the operation, or enqueue the work durably.
